Large flat paving stones of the same quarried grey stone, laid tight against each other in an irregular bond, their joints running right off all four edges of the frame. The stone is plain: a close even grain, small differences of value from one stone to the next, dark grime settled along every joint. Every stone is whole and flat and the surface is continuous. No single stone stands out from its neighbours. Nothing is broken, nothing is chipped, nothing has collapsed, and nothing has been put down on it. No border, no frame and no outline around the edge of the image; no decoration, no carving, no pattern, no centred feature; flat even light with no drop shadow and no vignette.
